## 2B.8 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** Lula’s 2024 record is **mostly favorable** for crisis de-escalation and channel preservation. In the main crises I found, he pushed dialogue, ceasefires, hostage release, and humanitarian access. The main caveat is that his Gaza rhetoric was sharply escalatory diplomatically, and the Brazil-China Ukraine initiative was criticized by Kyiv as exclusionary.

- **Claim:** Lula treated peace in Ukraine and Gaza as the default crisis response in talks with the U.S.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and Planalto separately reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts. This is direct evidence of de-escalatory crisis communication.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.8`, `2B.1`

- **Claim:** Brazil and China’s Ukraine proposal explicitly centered on dialogue and a ceasefire.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. That is strong channel-preservation evidence.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** Lula used the UN General Assembly to warn against militarization and insist on direct dialogue.
  - **Title:** [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 24, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said military spending and nuclear arsenals were driving confrontation and that direct dialogue was crucial. This is strong evidence of clear, crisis-aware de-escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** Lula’s Summit of the Future speech explicitly rejected returning to nuclear threats.
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world could not go back to living with nuclear threats and linked that warning to arms-race criticism and multilateral reform. This reinforces a diplomatic off-ramp rather than escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** Brazil joined a Gaza statement that demanded ceasefire, hostage release, and humanitarian aid.
  - **Title:** [Brasil assina declaração conjunta pelo fim dos ataques sobre Gaza](https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza)
  - **Publisher:** Agência Gov / MRE
  - **Date:** June 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza
  - **Claim-level summary:** The declaration said hostilities should stop, hostages should be released immediately and unconditionally, and humanitarian aid should reach civilians. This is direct crisis de-escalation and confidence-building evidence.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `2B.4`, `2B.7`

- **Claim:** The main counterevidence is Lula’s harsh Gaza rhetoric, which worsened diplomacy but did not displace his ceasefire posture.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The rhetoric triggered a diplomatic rupture with Israel and clearly increased tension. It is the strongest negative item, but it is not evidence that Lula abandoned diplomacy as the preferred route.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Ukraine criticized the Brazil-China peace initiative as exclusionary, which weakens but does not negate its de-escalatory intent.
  - **Title:** [Ukraine's Zelenskiy dismisses 'destructive' China-Brazil peace initiative](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 12, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/ukraines-zelenskiy-dismisses-destructive-chinabrazil-peace-initiative-3612966
  - **Claim-level summary:** Zelenskiy said Kyiv was not included and that the proposal lacked respect for Ukraine’s territorial integrity. This is real counterevidence against a fully effective peace process, but it still points to mediation rather than force.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.8`; also `1B.4`, `1B.8`, `2B.7`

### Search gap

I did **not** find strong evidence of:
- channel closure,
- refusal to negotiate,
- deliberate escalation in a crisis,
- or abandonment of ceasefire/off-ramp language.

The evidence base is strongest on **attempted de-escalation** and weakest on **successful settlement**.
